'''rebel router Rebel's to Rule''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[rebel router]]
* '''Published:''' 30 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Hidden Forest Trail|Endor-L-endorhiddenforesttrail.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Hidden Forest Trail
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Endor Hidden Forest Trail router.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my first light side deck so you'll probobly agree it kinda sucks.  But just for sure tell me if there is anything I could do to make it better.RATE ME!!

== Strategy ==

Get out a lot of ships to have strength in numbers.  Then orbit them at the related system to give strength to the troops down below.
